step1_analysis.description: A two-stage differential amplifier. The first stage consists of two differential pairs sharing active PMOS loads, acting as a summing amplifier (likely for phase interpolation or dual feedback). The second stage is a differential buffer.

paper_reference.title: An 8Gb/s 0.65mW/Gb/s Forwarded-Clock Receiver Using an ILO with Dual Feedback Loop and Quadrature Injection Scheme

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 1mA tail current for each of the 3 differential pairs (3mA total) at 1.8V supply: Power = 3mA * 1.8V = 5.4mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Power scales with the chosen tail currents. At 1.8V in SKY130, 5.4mW is expected for robust 8Gb/s operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vdsat ≈ 1.67mS. PMOS triode load R ≈ 1.45kΩ. Stage gain ≈ 2.4 V/V. Two stages = 5.76 V/V = 15.2 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends on the PMOS bias voltage. With PMOS gates tied to GND, they act as deep triode resistors, providing moderate gain and wide bandwidth.

bandwidth_3db.description: Frequency at which the voltage gain drops by 3dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pole = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * Cload). With Rload = 1.45kΩ and estimated parasitic Cload = 20fF, BW ≈ 5.5 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To support 8Gb/s (4GHz Nyquist), the bandwidth must be sufficiently high. The low-resistance triode loads ensure this.

sky130_expected.calculation: With 1mA tail current and 1.45kΩ load, max single-ended swing is 1.45V. Differential swing can approach 2.9V peak-to-peak, but will be limited by clipping.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sufficient swing is required to drive subsequent CML or CMOS stages.

propagation_delay.description: Time delay from input zero-crossing to output zero-crossing.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ≈ 0.69 * Rload * Cload per stage. 0.69 * 1.45k * 20fF ≈ 20ps per stage. Total ≈ 40ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast propagation is critical in a multi-gigabit forwarded-clock receiver.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, 3dB bandwidth, transient swing, and propagation delay of the summing amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Summing Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N0 N8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 LABEL_NET_0 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 LABEL_NET_2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 LABEL_NET_3 N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N2 N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N5 N4 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Vbias8 N8 0 0
Vbias7 N7 0 0

* Tail Current Sources
I1 N6 0 1m
I2 N1 0 1m
I3 N3 0 1m

* Inputs (8Gb/s data rate -> 4GHz Nyquist)
VIN1P LABEL_NET_0 0 DC 1.2 AC 0.5 PULSE(1.1 1.3 0 20p 20p 100p 240p)
VIN1N LABEL_NET_3 0 DC 1.2 AC -0.5 PULSE(1.3 1.1 0 20p 20p 100p 240p)
VIN2P LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 1.2 AC 0
VIN2N LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 1.2 AC 0

* Load Capacitors
C1 N5 0 10f
C2 N2 0 10f

* VCVS for Differential Signals (avoids vector math issues in .meas)
E1 out_diff 0 N2 N5 1
E2 in_diff 0 LABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_3 1

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  let gain_db_3db = dc_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=gain_db_3db fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 2p 1n
  meas tran vout_max max v(out_diff)
  meas tran vout_min min v(out_diff)
  let vout_swing = vout_max - vout_min
  print vout_swing
  meas tran t_delay trig v(in_diff) val=0 rise=2 targ v(out_diff) val=0 rise=2
  
  quit
.endc
.end
